_comment: Advisories the security audit (.github/workflows/platform-security.yml, scripts/audit-check.mjs) accepts for now. Each entry is one GitHub advisory, allowed ONLY in build and test tools (never in what ships to visitors) and only while no fixed version is published: the check fails again the moment a version above maxAffected exists, so the update is made and the entry removed. Any other high or critical advisory fails the check as before.

allow.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
allow.why: Reached only through vite and vitest (build and test tools). Every published picomatch (latest 4.0.7) is affected, so no update can clear it; npm's only suggestion is downgrading vite 8 to 6.
allow.approvedBy: the owner, in the session for task #193 (17 Nov 2026)
